text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm passing by the fields one day, when...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Brilliant! Your skin has a most lustrous
shine!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Elegant! You have a nice firm surface as
well. It
reflects a proper upbringing!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Oho? Why, what a coincidence!
Welcome,
welcome!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Excellent question! I was just
commending these
fine carrots on their
attributes!
choice_data_list: Um, what are you doing here...?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Listen well! I desire to create a
comfortable environment for all this
academy's students.
Naturally,
high-quality carrots are essential!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I require carrots high in nutritional
value—carrots that will make the mouth
water... In other words,
carrots grown
with love!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indisputable! Carrots grow best when
given love
and encouragement, just like
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And the essence of love is respect and
resolve! It requires the insight to see
somebody's true nature, and the
wherewithal to treat them with
dignity!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
To watch over them to the end, come
what may!
To praise them and push them
to their fullest
potential!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: That is love! But perhaps a more concrete example is in order.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Director Akikawa squats down and pulls
out a
carrot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crunch!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Like so!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Delectable! This flavor is the mark of a
carrot well
grown. The reward of the
conscientious gardener!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
My vision! I want to see every
Umamusume
mature as surely as these
carrots.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Until that day, I'll do whatever I can to
aid them
on their way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Director Akikawa's analogy is a little
hard to
follow, but there's no doubting
her passion.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Encouragement! Grow, my carrots! Grow
strong
and sturdy enough to reach the
sky!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Only then will you become high-quality
food for
our Umamusume! Now is the
time to grow,
carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's clear as day that Director Akikawa
sincerely
cares for her students.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that sincerity is something I firmly
believe
deserves respect. Which leads
me to say...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Shocking! What a bolt from the blue!
choice_data_list: Shall I help with the field work?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Very well! If you are willing to help, I
would be
delighted!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
My thanks! The students and the carrots
are
relying on you!
choice_data_list: Then, I will till the field.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to my daily training with 
<chrname>, I've been putting on
muscle recently. Power wells up from
within me,
and I plow the field easily!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Progress! Splendid work! Oh, do over
there next!
And this spot over here!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous! Now the fields are ready to
sow new
seeds.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Fine work, indeed! How ever can I thank
you?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Signed and sealed! I present you with these!
choice_data_list: Then, could we get some new traini...
Then, could you share some carrots...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
These cutting-edge training shoes were

developed using Umamusume
engineering.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Thus! I have dubbed them... Tracen Academy
Cleats! I oversaw the whole
design process
myself, from planning to
supervision!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
No need to thank me! The best results
require the
best equipment!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
These shoes will serve as the perfect
"carrots" for
raising a fine racer.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Expectations! Please keep raising your

Umamusume with love and care!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Director Akikawa radiates palpable
enthusiasm.
I'll give these shoes to
<chrname>
right away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every aspect of these shoes is
overflowing with Director Akikawa's love
for the Umamusume in
her care, down to
their very structure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us can almost hear cries of 
"Encouragement!" whenever my trainee puts
pressure on her heel. It motivates
both of us to
train harder than ever!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Then come, join me in
praising these
fine carrots!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
You there! How magnificently large you
are!
You've grown big and strong like a
tree!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Your turn!  Give them the praise they
deserve!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! Marvelous! What a
compliment!
choice_data_list: You're so dark in color! You look ...
Your color is so deep! Looks super...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Truly, my academy produces only the
best
trainers!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Conviction! You have made these carrots
even
more delicious!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later,
a large volume of carrots arrives at
my
door—a gift from Director Akikawa.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I rope in <chrname> and
some passing
friends, and we throw a
lavish carrot party.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After thoroughly enjoying the carrots,

<chrname> has loads more
energy for
training!
